compression: gzip, mtime=0 (no stored name or timestamp). compressed_sha256 identifies the committed bytes; it is not a reproducibility claim, because deflate output varies between compressors. The portable invariant is canonical_content_sha256, the contract-11 digest of the decompressed canonical JSON.

artifacts.untracked_input_reason: The HIFLD transmission-line component artifact is produced by pipelines.texas_hifld_lines from data/raw/hifld/, which .gitignore keeps out of Git, so this release's lineage is not fully resolvable from a clone. See data/sources/texas-hifld-lines-2024-09-30.json for that component's raw and normalized digests.

canonical_json_source: The canonical uncompressed release is exactly the gunzip of published_path; it is not tracked separately. canonical_content_sha256 is the contract-11 content digest of that JSON and canonical_json_bytes its length.
